headline: A poisoned jscrambler npm release seeding a cross-platform infostealer led a day dominated by software supply-chain attacks, China- and India-aligned espionage against Pakistani police, and fresh bootloader flaws.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep poisoning the developer supply chain, slipping a Rust infostealer into the jscrambler npm package minutes before defenders could react.
China-linked crews widened their reach this week, with Silver Fox fielding the Rust-based MODBEACON trojan even as separate China- and India-aligned operations looted Pakistani police networks.
Firmware moved back into the crosshairs as six new U-Boot flaws let attackers run code before a device even boots.

topics.title: China and India Spy on Balochistan Police
topics.latest_developments: The Record and The Hacker News reported July 10 and 11, 2026 that suspected China- and India-aligned threat actors ran separate espionage campaigns against Pakistani law enforcement, chiefly the Balochistan Police, breaching servers that hold criminal and citizen records between February 2024 and April 2026 and in some cases hitting the exact same systems.
topics.summary: The targeted force polices Pakistan's southwestern province, the site of a long-running separatist insurgency; the compromised assets ran web applications managing police and citizen data, so investigators should assume broad credential and record theft.

sources.title: Hackers Weaponize Balochistan Police Portal in Multi-Group Espionage Campaigns
China, India ran separate spying campaigns against same Pakistani police force

topics.title: Poisoned jscrambler npm Release
topics.latest_developments: The Hacker News reported July 11, 2026 that attackers compromised the jscrambler npm package so its 8.14.0 release runs a native infostealer on install through a preinstall hook that drops one build each for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with Socket flagging the release six minutes after publication.
topics.summary: jscrambler is a widely used JavaScript obfuscation and protection tool; anyone who installed version 8.14.0 ran the stealer, so teams should remove it, pin to a known-good release, and rotate exposed credentials.

sources.title: Compromised jscrambler 8.14.0 npm Release Drops Rust Infostealer During Install

topics.title: Ghost Accounts Map GitHub Orgs
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek reported July 11, 2026 that multiple campaigns run disposable ghost accounts to abuse the GitHub API, mapping organizations along with their repositories and members at scale for pre-attack reconnaissance.
topics.summary: The throwaway accounts pull repository and membership data through GitHub's API to profile targets before striking; organizations should tighten API rate limits and audit who can enumerate their members.

sources.title: Ghost Accounts Abuse GitHub API in Mass Recon Campaign

topics.title: Six U-Boot Bootloader Flaws
topics.latest_developments: Firmware security firm Binarly disclosed six new flaws July 10, 2026 in the U-Boot bootloader; four can crash a device, and two let an attacker who plants a malicious image run code before the device boots, opening the door to stealthy, persistent firmware implants.
topics.summary: U-Boot starts the hardware inside home routers, smart cameras, and the management chips in data-center servers; vendors need to ship firmware fixes, because code planted at boot survives operating-system reinstalls.

sources.title: New U-Boot flaws could enable stealthy firmware attacks
Six New U-Boot Flaws Could Let Malicious Images Crash Devices or Run Code at Boot

topics.title: Silver Fox Deploys MODBEACON RAT
topics.latest_developments: Chinese security firm QiAnXin attributed a new Rust-based remote access trojan called MODBEACON to the China-linked Silver Fox group on July 10, 2026, describing malware that uses gRPC streaming to encrypt its command-and-control traffic and spreads through counterfeit installers pushed by search-engine poisoning.
topics.summary: Silver Fox looks like a low-sophistication, high-volume operation, though QiAnXin says its organization runs deeper; users should avoid installers surfaced through search results and verify software sources.

sources.title: New MODBEACON RAT Uses gRPC Streaming for Encrypted C2 Traffic

business_politics.title: U.S. and Iran Escalate Fight Over Strait of Hormuz
business_politics.latest_developments: American forces launched fresh strikes on Iranian military sites after Tehran again declared the strait closed following a warning shot at a commercial vessel, and Iran said it struck U.S. bases in neighboring Gulf countries.
business_politics.summary: The United States and Iran traded attacks over the Strait of Hormuz, the chokepoint for roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil, with Iran firing on shipping and on targets in Jordan, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar while U.S. Central Command hit Iranian sites; Washington insists the waterway stays open, keeping a fragile ceasefire near collapse.

sources.title: U.S. and Iran Ramp Up Attacks in Fight Over Strait of Hormuz
US launches fresh strikes after Tehran declares Strait of Hormuz closed

business_politics.title: Senator Lindsey Graham Dies at 71
business_politics.latest_developments: Graham died Saturday evening, July 11, of a brief and sudden illness, his office said, leaving his South Carolina Senate seat open for the governor to fill.
business_politics.summary: Lindsey Graham, the South Carolina Republican who chaired the Senate Judiciary Committee and became one of President Trump's closest allies and the chamber's leading hawk on Iran and Israel, died at 71 after evolving from an early Trump critic into a central pillar of the president's agenda.

sources.title: Longtime Republican Sen. Lindsey Graham has died after a brief and sudden illness
US senator Lindsey Graham dies aged 71

business.title: Pennsylvania Joins $45 Million Cash App Settlement
business.latest_developments: Attorney General Dave Sunday announced Sunday, July 12, a $45 million multistate settlement with the owner of the mobile-payment app Cash App, with Pennsylvania set to collect $1,137,695.72.
business.summary: A national settlement resolves state claims against the company behind Cash App; the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania will receive $1,137,695.72 of the $45 million pot.

sources.title: Attorney General Sunday announces $45 million national settlement with Cash App owner

business.title: West Overton Distillery Bottles America 250 Cherry Bounce
business.latest_developments: The distillery at West Overton Village in Westmoreland County launched a historic cherry bounce to mark the nation's 250th anniversary.
business.summary: West Overton Village's distillery revived cherry bounce, a colonial cherry-infused whiskey, as its contribution to the semiquincentennial, betting on whiskey-making as a draw for the historic site.

sources.title: West Overton Village distillery launches historic cherry bounce for America 250

around_town.title: Parkway East Closure Snarls Homestead as Big Boy Draws Crowds
around_town.latest_developments: On the closure's first full day, thousands who came to Homestead to watch Union Pacific's Big Boy No. 4014 steam locomotive pass through compounded detour gridlock for hours Saturday.
around_town.summary: PennDOT's 25-day closure of the Parkway East (I-376) for the Commercial Street Bridge replacement is funneling roughly 100,000 daily vehicles onto detours through Homestead and Munhall, where the Big Boy's passage layered a crowd worse than Christmas onto already jammed streets, Munhall emergency management coordinator Daryyl Hunt said.

sources.title: Thousands view Big Boy train in Homestead, adding to local Parkway East detour traffic
Parkway East closure prompts traffic backups around Pittsburgh

around_town.title: PennDOT Launches Aggressive-Driving Crackdown
around_town.latest_developments: PennDOT and its safety partners kicked off an aggressive-driving enforcement campaign targeting speeding, tailgating, and running red lights.
around_town.summary: The statewide campaign steps up police enforcement against speeding, tailgating, and red-light running across Pennsylvania roads.

sources.title: PennDOT, Safety Partners kick off Aggressive Driving Enforcement Campaign

around_town.title: Jeannette Hires Three Officers to Curb Overtime
around_town.latest_developments: The Westmoreland County city of Jeannette hired three new police officers this week, which officials said should ease the department's ballooning overtime costs.
around_town.summary: Jeannette added three officers to its police force in a move officials framed as a way to rein in overtime spending.

sources.title: Jeannette hires 3 police officers to help rein in ballooning overtime costs

events.latest_developments: Picklesburgh comes back for an 11th year with a bigger festival and new pickle creations.
events.summary: Picklesburgh, Pittsburgh's pickle-themed food festival, returns larger with fresh pickle concoctions, extending a local obsession the Senator John Heinz History Center traces to Henry John Heinz's 1869 Anchor Pickle and Vinegar Works.

around_teams.latest_developments: Columnist Noah Hiles argued the Pirates and general manager Ben Cherington must give right-handed reliever Carmen Mlodzinski a bigger role.
around_teams.summary: In a Post-Gazette column, Noah Hiles wrote that the Pirates are wasting Carmen Mlodzinski in the bullpen and should lean on him more heavily as the club sorts out its late-inning arms.
